instruction: ERC-Clean Bus Expansion: `mcu.kicad_sch` is a native KiCad 10.0.2 schematic with an STM32 MCU (U1) and an ISSI IS62WV SRAM (U2). Start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. Its data bus pins are deliberately unconnected. Create eight individual net labels DATA0 through DATA7 so that U1 PA0 connects only to U2 IO0 on DATA0, PA1 connects only to IO1 on DATA1, and so on through PA7/IO7 on DATA7. Do not use an unexpanded bus expression such as DATA[0..7]. Preserve the existing U1, U2, C1-C4, R1-R3, and #PWR01-#PWR04 symbols with their references, values, footprints, and pin semantics. Do not add any component except exactly two `power:PWR_FLAG` symbols: connect one to the canonical KiCad +3V3 supply net (the task's 3V3 rail) and the other to GND. Keep the existing decoupling, control, and power-net connectivity intact, run KiCad 10.0.2 ERC, and resolve all electrical errors; embedded custom-library provenance warnings are not electrical connection errors. Save the completed native schematic as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch`.
